title: Track A Generation 1 — Emergence of Discovering Configurations

primary_criteria.P1: some configuration achieves behavioral discovery of persistent/grammar structures with matched-negative rejection in at least two independent runs
primary_criteria.selection_metric: verified discovery events on persistent_/grammar_composed families per configuration, tie-broken by fewer false promotions

pack_plan: 4 persistent ladder positives + 4 matched negatives + observation-routing sanity positive + random-routing sanity negative + 2 grammar-composed positives + 2 grammar matched negatives (14 packs)

structure_grammar.composition: 2-3 motifs sampled per matched pair from the suite master seed
structure_grammar.acceptance: deterministic resampling until the identifiability preflight passes; the designer does not hand-pick instances
structure_grammar.note: grammar instances are machine-composed; the suite designer knows the grammar, not the sampled structure

deferred_to_generation_2: codex reasoning-effort ablation (default xhigh in generation 1)

contract_additions_over_v039.implication_provenance: per-context {statistic, held_out=true, null_reference_position, computation_hash} required for terminal resolutions
contract_additions_over_v039.consistency: falsified: at most one context with position >= 0.95; validated: at least two

prompt_policy: P1 adds only the null-referenced implication requirement; P2 additionally mandates enumeration of competing task formulations on the four generic assumption axes. No structure-specific vocabulary.
evaluation: locked v0.3.7-lineage evaluator reused verbatim; per-configuration aggregates are the agent-by-seed aggregates; selection table computed from evaluated packs
old_gates_status: diagnostic only per the v0.4.0 policy; FSPR <= 0.20 and evidence-based conditions remain internal requirements of discovery events

isolation.claude: workdir isolation + deny rules + transcript audit (as v0.3.8/9)
isolation.codex: workspace-write sandbox (network disabled, writes confined to workdir) + transcript audit; read isolation is weaker than the claude deny rules and is recorded as a parity limitation

predictions.primary: at least one configuration separates from the baseline (C3) on persistent/grammar discovery events; if none does, the bottleneck is not addressable by model/scaffold variation at this budget and stopping rule 1 fires
predictions.secondary: cross-model populations show lower shared-blind-spot overlap than same-model populations (diagnostic)

stopping_rules: generation 2 proceeds only with configurations showing >= 2 verified discovery events
if no configuration reaches 2 events, synthetic search stops and the best configuration proceeds to the IEEE-CIS bridge (policy stopping rule 1)
